about_the_game:
Cozy Florist is a peaceful life simulation where you bring your grandmother’s old flower shop back to life 🌿
In this quiet little shop, long untouched by time, you’ll rediscover traces of the past, grow your own flowers 🌸, arrange them with care, and get closer to the heart of the town with every bouquet 💐

Plant your seeds 🌱, nurture your plants, and craft colorful arrangements to delight your customers. Each design reflects your creativity and unique touch 🎨

As you meet the townspeople 🏘️, you’ll step into the intertwined stories of over 30 characters. Each one carries their own joys, sorrows, and secrets 💭 and through friendship, the mysteries of the town slowly unfold 🌙

Over time, expand your shop, organize your shelves, paint your walls, and place your favorite vases and pots 🌷 to express your style.
All of this happens to calm music 🎶, at your own pace, without any rush.

Cozy Florist brings together nature, memories, and human connection in a warm, emotional, and relaxing experience 💖

🌷 Key Features

• 🌿 Restore your grandmother’s flower shop to life
• 🌼 Grow your own flowers, care for them, and create colorful arrangements
• 🏘️ Meet over 30 townspeople and uncover their stories
• 🌙 Discover the hidden mysteries of the town
• 💐 Decorate and personalize every corner of your shop
• 🎶 Enjoy soothing music and a cozy atmosphere
• ☕ A calm and heartwarming cozy life experience
